name: spring-boot
title: Spring Boot Web Service
blurb: Java 21 Spring Boot 3 web service on Maven: a wc-style /stats endpoint, a pure service, and a JUnit 5 + MockMvc suite

verify.name: endpoint
verify.cmd: mvn -q spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.arguments=--server.port=18080 > /tmp/springboot-run.log 2>&1 & RUN_PID=$!; up=0; for i in $(seq 1 90); do if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:18080/ 2>/dev/null; then up=1; break; fi; sleep 1; done; if [ "$up" -ne 1 ]; then echo 'app did not come up' >&2; cat /tmp/springboot-run.log >&2; kill $RUN_PID 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; stats=$(curl -s 'http://localhost:18080/stats?text=hello%20world'); echo "stats: $stats"; ok=1; echo "$stats" | grep -q lines || ok=0; echo "$stats" | grep -q words || ok=0; echo "$stats" | grep -q bytes || ok=0; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'http://localhost:18080/stats'); echo "missing-text status: $code"; [ "$code" = "400" ] || ok=0; kill $RUN_PID 2>/dev/null; wait $RUN_PID 2>/dev/null; [ "$ok" -eq 1 ]
